subject: Medford Vocational Technical High School Program Expansion
overview: The School Committee reviewed multiple new vocational program approvals and grants, discussed upcoming kindergarten registration timelines, and voted to invite state legislators to discuss school funding priorities.

items.title: Jingle Bell Fun Run Awards
items.summary: Judy Lonergan presented trophies and checks to local schools following the Jingle Bell Fun Run, which raised approximately $23,000 for school organizations.

items.title: Medford Children's Art Showcase
items.summary: Jennifer Desatels announced that the 2016 citywide art exhibit would move to the River's Edge building due to reconstruction at the previous mall location.

items.title: Minutes, Bills, and Payroll
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the January 11 meeting, various bill transfers, and school payrolls.

items.title: Project 351 Recognition
items.summary: Eighth-grade student Joelle Brown was recognized for her selection as Medford's representative to the Project 351 community service program.

items.title: Focus K-2 Literacy Grant
items.summary: The Committee reviewed a $112,000 state grant to pilot a research-based kindergarten literacy curriculum across Medford, Cambridge, and Malden.

items.title: Vocational Technical High School Reports
items.summary: Director Heidi Riccio reported on Chapter 74 environmental science approval, a health dual enrollment program with Bunker Hill, and new grants for adult building trades.

items.title: Registration and Selection Processes
items.summary: Superintendent Belson provided advanced information on the 2016-2017 registration timelines for kindergarten and middle school selection.

items.title: Meeting with State Legislators
items.summary: Approved a motion to invite the state legislative delegation to a public meeting to discuss charter school impacts and funding for kindergarten aides.

items.title: Academic Support Grant Report
items.summary: Deputy Superintendent Nelson detailed a $15,300 grant for MCAS and PARCC preparation programs, including new Saturday sessions for eighth-grade students.

items.title: Class Size and Financial Reports
items.summary: The Committee reviewed secondary class size data and a mid-year financial report that highlighted a 23.7% increase in transportation costs for homeless students.

items.title: Condolence Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences to the family of Joseph LaPorta, a former administrator of driver's education and school security.
